summary.text: MORK KRAFTVERK AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2013-10-25. MORK KRAFTVERK AS builds and operates Mork Kraftverk, producing and selling electricity. Its main industry code is 35.121: production of electricity from hydropower. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 23 060 000 NOK and the annual result was 2 677 000 NOK; operating income was up from 13 125 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -6 465 000 NOK in 2024 to 2 677 000 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 13 333 000 NOK in 2024 to 16 011 000 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-11 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
